details: The package @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui-cypress@9.0.5 is a trojanized Cypress helper package. The preinstall hook (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun/releases, then executes a 727KB heavily-obfuscated JavaScript file (math_init.js) through the downloaded binary. The obfuscated payload uses the javascript-obfuscator dictionary-array pattern with thousands of _0x-prefixed identifiers and a base64-like decode function, making static analysis of its runtime behaviour infeasible. The package also depends on two other packages (@servicetitan/titan-chat-ui-common, @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-api) that are themselves confirmed malware, indicating a coordinated supply-chain compromise of the ServiceTitan npm namespace.
